source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?namesakeLabel ?placeLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?nm) AS ?namesake) (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?place) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?nm) AS ?n) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q1248784 ; wdt:P138 ?nm ; wdt:P931 ?c . ?nm wdt:P31 wd:Q5 . } GROUP BY ?item HAVING(?n = 1) } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160
